title: AcuityMD, which provides AI tools that automate sales call recaps, CRM data entry, and more for medtech companies, raised an $80M Series C at a $955M valuation (Brock E.W. Turner/Axios)
summary: Brock E.W. Turner / Axios: AcuityMD, which provides AI tools that automate sales call recaps, CRM data entry, and more for medtech companies, raised an $80M Series C at a $955M valuation — Medtech software platform AcuityMD raised $80 million in Series C funding at a $955 million valuation, CEO Michael Monovoukas tells Axios Pro exclusively.
